prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1238; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured reports the other vehicle backed into the driver's side door while the insured was stopped. Both vehicles drivable. Photos requested from insured and on file.

Entry 2: Claimant's vehicle inspected at repair facility. Rear bumper and quarter panel damage consistent with reported impact. Estimate prepared and submitted for review. Liability appears probable against the other driver based on statements and damage pattern.

Entry 3: Notice of representation received. Claimant is now represented by counsel, who has requested that all future communication be directed to their office. Claimant reports neck strain following the collision and has begun treatment with a physical therapist. Medical authorization requested through counsel.

Entry 4: Counsel's office provided initial treatment records showing diagnosis of cervical strain with recommended course of physical therapy. Records logged and forwarded to medical review. Reserve adjusted to reflect bodily injury component. Follow-up requested on treatment progress and any missed appointments.

Entry 5: Status call held with counsel's office. Settlement discussion deferred pending completion of treatment and final medical report. Property damage estimate approved and payment issued to repair facility. Diary set for thirty days to review updated therapy notes.
